ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black pigmentation across the central fluke body. Contiguous high-intensity (white) regions are localized at the distal tips of both lobes; the right lobe contains a larger triangular white patch extending along the outer trailing edge, while the left lobe displays white streaks and a smaller tip patch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extreme irregularity on the left lobe consisting of three major concave voids (notches) of high pixel-amplitude. The right lobe exhibits fine-scale, low-amplitude serrations (micro-peaks) along the distal 50% of its trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex upward sweep; the trajectory on the left lobe is severely interrupted by deep tissue-loss concavities, whereas the right lobe follows a more continuous parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, roughly circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tip and outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four parallel, vertical high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) on the central-left ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe physical trauma evidenced by multiple deep, healed notches on the left trailing edge and prominent linear rake marks on the left lobe pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'stepped' silhouette on the left lobe resulting from the sequence of three large, deep indentations.
